summary: Frontend E2E testing for Benchmark Workouts Parts 7/9/10 on 1024x768 tablet viewport. Verified: (1) Setup 'Begin Test' navigates to /benchmark/player/{id} — placeholder gone. (2) Player renders SIM DATA badge, interval label, primary metric with unit, secondary grid (3s POWER, AVG interval, HEART RATE, CADENCE, ELAPSED), RPE +/- controls, coaching card and DEV inject buttons (Power fade / Reset / Dropout). (3) Ramp Test → begin, ramp target increased visible in target text, Stop → 'I reached my limit' navigated to /benchmark/result/current with ESTIMATED FTP primary card + 0–100 CONFIDENCE meter (rendered 11% Low quality for ~10s SIM run, colour-coded), MEASUREMENTS list (Estimated FTP, Maximal Aerobic Power, Elapsed 0:10, Perceived exertion 5/10), insight bulb card, feel chips + notes input, and Accept/Save/Exclude buttons. (4) Accept on SIM run shows yellow dev-notice (testID result-dev-notice) explaining profile was NOT changed. 'Back to Benchmark Workouts' returns to landing. (5) Landing shows Ramp Test row in RECENT RESULTS with 'Accepted' chip, 11% confidence and 'simulated' label. (6) TRAINING ZONES card renders all 7 zones Z1..Z7 with 'Based on an FTP of 287 W' fallback + watt ranges. (7) BENCHMARK HISTORY renders ftp-trend bars once result exists. (8) Cadence Control: primary label = CADENCE with rpm unit (verified). Target rpm text is conditional on step having cadenceTarget — shows during main interval, absent during Warm-Up (correct behaviour, not a bug). (9) Aerobic Efficiency (submaximal) pause: NO maximal-effort pause-confirm modal appeared — paused directly and Resume works. (10) Ramp (maximal) pause DOES show the pause-confirm warning modal (control test). (11) Safety stop (Pain or discomfort) on Cadence Control: stayed on /benchmark/player/… (did NOT navigate to result page) and rendered the yellow safety guidance card (testID player-safety) with 'Stop and rest… seek appropriate medical advice…'. No regressions or React Native red-screen errors observed.

issues: Post-stop summary card still says 'Result calculation, confidence and accept/exclude arrive in the next update (Part 9)'. Since Part 9 has shipped and safety stops correctly bypass the result page, this message is now outdated. Consider updating this note text in frontend/app/benchmark/player/[id].tsx around line 342 for stopped_early state to something like 'Safety stops are not scored — take care and try again when you are ready.'

action_items: Optional: Update the stopped_early summary note in /app/frontend/app/benchmark/player/[id].tsx (~line 342) — currently claims Part 9 is upcoming, but Part 9 shipped. Note now only shows on safety-stop path which is fine, but wording is stale.
critical_code_review_comments: Ramp final watts calc in pickStop (player/[id].tsx ~L273-277) computes stages from stepElapsed and rampStep, but rampTarget state may already reflect the current stage — worth a unit test to make sure the finalWatts matches the on-screen target when the user hits 'reached limit'. For very short runs (<rampStepSec) it correctly clamps to Math.max(0, stages-1).

In Cadence Control the 'Target ... rpm' hint only appears on intervals with cadenceTarget. Warm-up doesn't have one so no target text renders during warm-up — behaviour is correct but not obvious; consider showing a subtle 'no cadence target' hint or hiding the primary card during warm-up for cadence tests. Nice-to-have, not a bug.
seed_data_creation: One SIM Ramp Test benchmark result was accepted for user_greenlantern via the UI flow to verify Recent Results / FTP trend rendering. Marked isDevData=true so profile.ftp remained 287 (unchanged) — expected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow: two <input> fields on landing, then click text 'Sign in'. Credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. To reach the player fast, POST-login navigate directly to /benchmark/setup/{testId} and click setup-next through the wizard (readiness needs all rd-*-no answers; equipment needs eq-smart_trainer for power tests). Player testIDs: player-begin, player-pause, player-resume, player-stop, stop-limit/pain/equipment/traffic/unwell/other, ramp-10/15/20/25 (only on Ramp ready state), rpe-plus/minus, inject-fade/reset/interrupt, player-safety (card after safety stop). Result testIDs: result-primary, result-accept/later/exclude, feel-easy/right/hard/toohard, result-notes, result-dev-notice (only on accept of SIM run), result-done. Landing testIDs: bm-recent, bm-zones, bm-history, ftp-trend, accept-{id}/exclude-{id} on pending. Short ramp runs (~10s) produce ~11% Low-quality confidence — expected. Setup takes ~4 setup-next clicks to move through Overview → Readiness → Equipment → Sensors → Environment → Summary (6 steps).
rca_of_issue: No blocking issues found. Only a minor stale copy in the player 'stopped_early' summary card referring to Part 9 as upcoming — see action_items.
